    (if c3_equal m p q n then 34 else 31) +
    2 * (if n = 0 then 6 else if n = 16 then 15 else 7 * n + 10) +
    cleanse_functional_steps p n

definitions.name: c3_equal
definitions.equation:
forall n p m q.
    c3_equal m p q n <=>
    (forall i. i < n ==> m (word_add p (word i)) = m (word_add q (word i)))

definitions.name: c3_reference_image
definitions.equation:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding a.
    c3_reference_image file_bytes initial_rw padding a =
    (if c3_immutable (val a)
     then file_bytes (val a - 587202560)
     else if c3_initialized_rw (val a) then initial_rw a else padding a)

definitions.name: c3_file_code
definitions.equation:

    c3_file_code file_bytes <=>
    (forall i. i < 89 ==> file_bytes (4384 + i) = EL i c3_caller_mc) /\
    (forall i. i < 6 ==> file_bytes (4144 + i) = EL i c3_crypto_plt_prefix) /\
    (forall i. i < 6 ==> file_bytes (4160 + i) = EL i c3_cleanse_plt_prefix)

definitions.name: c3_loaded_code
definitions.equation:

    c3_loaded_code s <=>
    bytes_loaded s (word 587206944) c3_caller_mc /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 587206704) c3_crypto_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 587206720) c3_cleanse_plt_prefix /\
    bytes_loaded s (word 270800960) crypto_memcmp_mc /\

    read (memory :> bytes64 (word 587218904)) s = word 270800848

definitions.name: c3_scratch
definitions.equation:
forall stackpointer a.
    c3_scratch stackpointer a <=>
    assurance_region (word_sub stackpointer (word 48)) 48 a

definitions.name: c3_allowed_read
definitions.equation:
forall rp ordinary p q n stackpointer a.
    c3_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n a <=>
    rp a /\
    ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region p n a \/
     assurance_region q n a \/
     c3_scratch stackpointer a \/
     assurance_region stackpointer 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 587218896) 8 a \/
     assurance_region (word 587218904) 8 a)

definitions.name: c3_allowed_write
definitions.equation:
forall q m wp ordinary p n stackpointer a.
    c3_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m a <=>
    wp a /\
    ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region p n a \/ c3_scratch stackpointer a)

definitions.name: c3_allowed_fetch
definitions.equation:
forall xp ordinary a.
    c3_allowed_fetch xp ordinary a <=>
    xp a /\
    ordinary a /\
    (assurance_region (word 587206944) 89 a \/
     assurance_region (word 587206704) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 587206720) 6 a \/
     assurance_region (word 270800960) 95 a \/
     assurance_region (word 270800848) 97 a)

definitions.name: c3_cleansed_memory
definitions.equation:
forall p n m addr.
    c3_cleansed_memory m p n addr =
    (if assurance_region p n (val addr) then word 0 else m addr)

definitions.name: c3_result
definitions.equation:
forall m p q n.
    c3_result m p q n =
    (if c3_equal m p q n
     then if c3_equal (c3_cleansed_memory m p n) p q n
          then word 1
          else word 0
     else word 2)

definitions.name: c3_steps
definitions.equation:
forall m q p n.
    c3_steps p q n m =
    (if c3_equal m p q n then 34 else 31) +
    2 * bp_assurance_call_steps n +
    cleanse_functional_steps p n

definitions.name: c3_frame
definitions.equation:
forall q m p n stackpointer.
    c3_frame stackpointer p q n m =
    MAYCHANGE [RIP; RSP; RAX; RDI; RSI; RDX; R10; R11] ,,
    MAYCHANGE SOME_FLAGS ,,
    MAYCHANGE
    [memory :> bytes (p,n);
     memory :> bytes (word_sub stackpointer (word 48),48)] ,,
    MAYCHANGE [events]

definitions.name: c3_pre
definitions.equation:
forall ra a lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding m s wp rp xp ordinary q stackpointer p n.
    c3_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw client_padding
    stackpointer
    ra
    p
    q
    n
    m
    rp
    wp
    xp
    ordinary
    (s,a) <=>
    n < 2 EXP 64 /\
    48 <= val stackpointer /\
    val stackpointer MOD 16 = 8 /\
    val stackpointer + 8 < 2 EXP 64 /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val ra) /\
    ~(ra = word 587206944) /\
    read RIP s = word 587206944 /\
    read RSP s = stackpointer /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) s = ra /\
    C_ARGUMENTS [p; q; word n] s /\
    read memory s = m /\
    (read DF s <=> false) /\
    ~bit 18 (read rflags s) /\
    e5_normal_flags s /\
    assurance_canonical48 (val (read ABI_FS_BASE a)) /\
    fb_file_code lib_file /\
    clw_file_code lib_file /\
    fb_full_image lib_file lib_rw lib_padding m /\
    c3_file_code client_file /\
    c3_full_image client_file client_rw client_padding m /\
    c3_loaded_code s /\
    c3_got s /\
    (forall addr.
         lw_image_domain addr
         ==> rp addr /\
             ordinary addr /\
             (xp addr <=> lw_execute addr) /\
             (wp addr <=> lw_image_write addr)) /\
    (forall addr.
         c3_image_domain addr
         ==> rp addr /\
             ordinary addr /\
             (xp addr <=> c3_image_execute addr) /\
             (wp addr <=> c3_image_write addr)) /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val q) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val p) n /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer - 48) 48 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. wp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer - 48) 48 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) (val stackpointer) 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 587218896 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. rp a /\ ordinary a) 587218904 8 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 587206944 89 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 587206704 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 587206720 6 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 270800960 95 /\
    assurance_span_ok (\a. xp a /\ ordinary a) 270800848 97 /\
    (forall addr.
         ~(assurance_region p n addr /\ c3_scratch stackpointer addr)) /\
    (forall addr.
         ~(assurance_region q n addr /\ c3_scratch stackpointer addr)) /\
    (forall addr.
         ~(assurance_region p n addr /\ assurance_region stackpointer 8 addr)) /\
    (forall addr.
         assurance_region p n addr
         ==> ~(assurance_region (word 587206944) 89 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 587206704) 6 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 587206720) 6 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 587218896) 8 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 587218904) 8 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 270800960) 95 addr \/
               assurance_region (word 270800848) 97 addr))

definitions.name: c3_scalar_post
definitions.equation:
forall ra stackpointer p q n m s t.
    c3_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s t <=>
    read RIP t = ra /\
    val (read RSP t) = val stackpointer + 8 /\
    read RAX t = c3_result m p q n /\
    (forall i. i < n ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i)) = word 0) /\
    (forall i.
         i < n
         ==> read memory t (word_add q (word i)) =
             c3_cleansed_memory m p n (word_add q (word i))) /\
    (forall addr.
         ~(assurance_region p n (val addr) \/
           c3_scratch stackpointer (val addr))
         ==> read memory t addr = m addr) /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 stackpointer) t = ra /\
    read RBX t = read RBX s /\
    read RBP t = read RBP s /\
    read R12 t = read R12 s /\
    read R13 t = read R13 s /\
    read R14 t = read R14 s /\
    read R15 t = read R15 s /\
    (read DF t <=> false) /\
    c3_loaded_code t /\
    c3_got t /\
    c3_frame stackpointer p q n m s t

definitions.name: c3_public_post
definitions.equation:
forall stackpointer ra p q n m s a t.
    c3_public_post stackpointer ra p q n m s a t <=>
    c3_scalar_post stackpointer ra p q n m s (FST t) /\
    SND t = a /\
    abi_required_controls_preserved a (SND t)

definitions.name: c3_step_policy
definitions.equation:
forall rp wp stackpointer p q n m xp ordinary remaining target source.
    c3_step_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary remaining source
    target <=>
    assurance_step_policy (c3_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
    (c3_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m)
    (c3_allowed_fetch xp ordinary)
    source
    target /\
    (remaining = 1 ==> assurance_actual_ret 1 source target) /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source

definitions.name: c3_segment_policy
definitions.equation:
forall remaining rp wp stackpointer p q n m xp ordinary target source.
    c3_segment_policy stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary remaining source
    target <=>
    assurance_step_policy (c3_allowed_read rp ordinary stackpointer p q n)
    (c3_allowed_write wp ordinary stackpointer p q n m)
    (c3_allowed_fetch xp ordinary)
    source
    target /\
    abi_all_decodes_caller_scalar source

definitions.name: c3_saved_prefix
definitions.equation:
forall s stackpointer p n m q t.
    c3_saved_prefix stackpointer p q n m s t <=>
    read RBX t = p /\
    read RBP t = word n /\
    read R12 t = q /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 8))) t = read R13 s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 16))) t = read R12 s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 24))) t = read RBP s /\
    read (memory :> bytes64 (word_sub stackpointer (word 32))) t = read RBX s /\
    (forall addr.
         ~c3_scratch stackpointer (val addr) ==> read memory t addr = m addr) /\
    (forall i.
         i < n
         ==> read memory t (word_add p (word i)) = m (word_add p (word i))) /\
    (forall i.
         i < n
         ==> read memory t (word_add q (word i)) = m (word_add q (word i))) /\
    c3_loaded_code t /\
    c3_got t

definitions.name: c3_prefix_frame

definitions.name: c3_crypto_ready
definitions.equation:
forall wp lib_file rp xp ordinary a p q n m stackpointer s t.
    c3_crypto_ready lib_file stackpointer p q n m rp wp xp ordinary s a t <=>
    bp_e2_crypto_public_pre lib_file (read memory t) (read memory t)

    (word 587206968)
    p

    (read memory t)
    rp

    (t,a) /\

definitions.name: c3w_seed
definitions.equation:
forall lib_file client_file payload addr.
    c3w_seed lib_file client_file payload addr =
    (if fb_immutable (val addr)
     then lib_file (val addr - 268435456)

    write (bytes64 (word 3145736)) (word 4194304)
    (write (bytes64 (word 587218896)) (word 270800960)
    (write (bytes64 (word 587218904)) (word 270800848)

definitions.name: c3w_state
definitions.equation:

    c3w_state lib_file client_file payload p q n =
    x86state_RECORD (word 587206944)
    (\j.
         if j = word 7
         then p
         else if j = word 6
              then q
              else if j = word 2
                   then word n
                   else if j = word 4 then word 3145736 else word 0)
    (\j. word 0)
    (\j. word 0)
    (word 2)
    (c3w_memory lib_file client_file payload)
    []

definitions.name: c3w_write

definitions.name: c3_entry_witness
definitions.equation:
forall lib_file client_file payload p q n.
    c3_entry_witness lib_file client_file payload p q n <=>
    (exists lib_rw lib_padding client_rw client_padding m rp wp xp ordinary s a.
         c3_pre lib_file lib_rw lib_padding client_file client_rw
         client_padding
         (word 3145736)
         (word 4194304)
         p
         q
         n
         m
         rp
         wp
         xp
         ordinary
         (s,a) /\
         (forall i.
              i < n
              ==> m (word_add p (word i)) = payload (word_add p (word i))) /\
         (forall i.
              i < n
              ==> m (word_add q (word i)) = payload (word_add q (word i))) /\
         (p = word 0 /\ q = word 0 /\ n = 0 ==> ~rp 0))
